meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? We're not stepping anywhere, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Same team would have meant a phone call before the gradebook, Hale. Withdraw the zero, and then we can talk about what comes next.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, and that you tell me in writing who decided on it and whether Owen was heard before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and a straight answer on who decided and whether Owen was heard first.
What moved her: nothing, since the praise and "I just want us to be on the same team here." got no ground at all.
What cost ground: "Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?", because asking her to do your job costs you her respect.
Try next time: when she first asks who decided and whether Owen was heard, answer that directly, own that the zero was entered before the call home, and then put a dated document on the table.
